I am an old woman with no schooling and little cash, so I cannot buy chemical fertilizer or improved seeds from the market. I will use the manure from my goats and chickens to feed the soil, and I will plant the maize seed I saved from last year’s harvest. This plot is small enough that my children and I can weed and harvest it ourselves without hiring anyone, and I will rely on Allah to send the rain because I have no means to irrigate.
